<article title="Refund timelines">
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. Your bank may take a further three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

If you chose store credit, it appears in your account as soon as the return is checked in, usually the same day.

If more than 15 business days have passed since the carrier delivered your return to us and no refund has appeared, contact us with your order number and we will check the return with our warehouse.

</article>

Customer first name: Astrid
<request>
three weeks, no refund
i sent the jacket back three weeks ago, tracking shows you received it, and nothing has come back to my card.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Astrid,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry the refund hasn't arrived yet. Our policy is to issue refunds to the original payment method within five business days after the return reaches our warehouse. Your bank may then take a further three to ten business days to show the credit.

If more than 15 business days have passed since the carrier delivered your return and no refund has appeared, please reply with your order number and we will check the return with our warehouse. A specialist can follow up from there.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
